title: Portfolio - Product Feedback Intelligence API
description: Local product feedback intelligence workflow: validates feedback intake, classifies theme/sentiment/urgency via an LLM-in-the-loop classifier with a deterministic fallback and confidence gate, derives urgency, scores priority, gates churn-risk/critical items for human review, and emits a redacted audit event.
notes: The LLM (Ollama) classifier path is env-switchable and demonstrated manually; CI and the behavioral eval run the deterministic stub so the suite is offline and reproducible. n8nWorkflowId is populated by the first Sync-N8nWorkflowFromSdk run.
